# arcane_command (Data Source)

Runs an Arcane command and reads its result. A command is an action that a resource kind defines, run with `POST <collection>/<command>`.

The command runs on every plan, apply and refresh, so use only commands that do not change state. Use the `arcane_command` resource for a command that has side effects. The token needs the RBAC `commands` permission `<plural>/<command>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The command runs on every plan, apply and refresh, so use it only for commands that do not change state.
data "arcane_command" "pet_summary" {
  api_version = "sample.arcane.pubg.io/v1"
  kind        = "Pet"
  namespace   = "default"
  command     = "summary"
}

output "pet_count" {
  value     = jsondecode(data.arcane_command.pet_summary.object).status.count
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_version` (String) apiVersion of the resource kind the command belongs to, not of the command object, such as `sample.arcane.pubg.io/v1`.
- `command` (String) Name of the command, as API discovery lists it for the kind.
- `kind` (String) Kind of the resource the command belongs to, not of the command object.

### Optional

- `body` (String, Sensitive) YAML of the command object. Always sensitive. When it is empty or has no `kind`, the provider sends the command kind that API discovery lists. It does not fill `apiVersion`. Arcane API servers that do not yet accept a command body without `apiVersion` reject it with 422, so write `apiVersion` in the body for them. When the command fails, string values from `body` that the server repeats in its error are shown as `******`.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the resource kind. Required for a namespaced kind, and not allowed for a cluster-scoped one.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) API path the command was sent to
- `object` (String, Sensitive) Command object the server returned, as JSON, exactly as received. Always sensitive. Read a result with `jsondecode(data.arcane_command.x.object)`.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
